# Options

The OOC consent preferences as a tab of the Game Options window instead of a window of their own; the consent keybind
opens the options on this tab. Consent is stored per player on the server, so the tab keeps its own Save button rather
than the shared Apply row.

Entry point: `WolfgateConsentTab`, added to `OptionsMenu` at `OptionsMenu.ConsentTabIndex` by a marked edit.
